endpoint: GET {RISK_URL}/book/stats?grade=B (implemented by services/risk, called by credit)
note: What credit expects from Kristian's loan book simulator. Header X-MS-Internal-Key. Credit also accepts default_rate_pct, or computes the rate from defaults / loans. Until risk answers, credit uses its own mock table and says source: mock. The rate is from the simulated book, so it is always labeled simulated.
